name: unifictional-platform
description: One repo for everything Unifictional ships: the marketing site + automated site builder, the Website Studio, the Client Portal (SEO Autopilot) and the Unifictional 3D Studio. Each app keeps its own package.json; these scripts just reach into them.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix unifictional-site install && npm --prefix "Client Portal" install && npm --prefix "3D Studio" install && npm --prefix "Website Studio" install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix unifictional-site run lint && npm --prefix "Client Portal" run lint && npm --prefix "3D Studio" run lint
